_comment: Committed master seed list of Jivo Zepto product VARIANTs that the search API never reliably emits (Algolia variant-rollup collapses pack-size siblings, and the bare-brand query is in-stock-gated). scrape.js PDP-probes each at every serviceable store via bff-gateway lms/api/v2/get_page?page_type=PDP&product_variant_id=<variantId> to recover authoritative per-store price + availableQuantity, INCLUDING out-of-stock and rollup-hidden variants. The variantIds are catalog-global (store-independent); only price/stock vary per store. Source: the public Zepto /pvid/<variantId> URL index (Google) + live PDP verification (Agent run 2026-06-04, zcat). No login / no proxy needed to USE these (the gateway PDP route is reachable from the DC IP). To ADD a new hidden variant later: find its /pvid/<id> on zepto.com (or owner-supplied), confirm via the PDP route, append here. search-discovered (in-stock) variants are still captured live by scrape.js and need NOT be listed here. UNION REBUILD 2026-06-09 (zepto-seed/W1): the seed is now the COMPLETE known-variant union — (a) the prior seed, (b) every Jivo zepto id in tools/pricematch/sku_map.json, (c) every distinct variant_id ever seen in result.json across all pincodes. PDP now probes EVERY serviceable store for ALL known variants, so n/s is AUTHORITATIVE: a SKU is "not here" only when the PDP route says so, never because Algolia search lagged. (Root cause of the owner-caught 560005 false n/s on CANOLA 1+1L 50b56b7f @ ~Rs469 — it was search-discovered but unseeded, so absent at stores where search did not surface it.) Enlarging this list is data-only and tomorrow-safe: it only makes the next sweep more complete (scrape.js untouched, result.json contract unchanged). Cost: one extra PDP probe per serviceable store per added variant (11 -> 23 seeds = +12 probes/store).
